item.title: [6.9] India's benchmark bond breaks 4-day falling streak as value investors return
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds have rebounded following a significant rise in yields, drawing investors back into the market. The benchmark bond yield has risen due to a central bank policy rate hike and liquidity measures. The rupee has appreciated against the dollar after the central bank implemented new measures to support the currency.

item.title: [6.9] Global Market: BoE's Megan Greene says UK interest rates may not be restrictive enough
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Bank of England policymaker Megan Greene said the IMF’s upward revision to the UK’s economic growth forecast supports her view that monetary policy remains insufficiently restrictive. She warned that delaying interest rate hikes could prolong inflationary pressures, highlighting divisions among policymakers over balancing inflation control against economic growth and borrowing costs.
